B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when a fraction is only simplified or a mixed number is only normalized without creating a common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator directly.
Tag when same-denominator fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the step of finding or creating a common denominator.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fractional parts before the final fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize fractional form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more workable equivalent form, such as simplifying a fraction part or converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part into standard mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is rewritten into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a fraction part is simplified to an equivalent reduced fraction before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that is preparation for mixed-number subtraction.
Do not tag for final-answer simplification after subtraction unless the step is specifically simplifying a starting fractional part.

skills.name: Align mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers and mixed numbers in aligned whole-part and fraction-part form so corresponding parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over the relevant denominator.
Tag when the solution explicitly separates or matches whole parts and fraction parts for subtraction in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction problems.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number into standard mixed form.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts once the representation is already set.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution notes a negative fractional difference and borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no borrowing/regrouping is needed.
Do not tag for ordinary subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts without converting 1 whole into fractional units.

skills.name: Compose simplified result
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the final answer in lowest terms, including reducing to an integer or zero when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution combines whole-part and fraction-part results into a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies the final result, including reducing a fraction, converting 0 over n to 0, or omitting a zero whole part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for intermediate conversions used before subtraction.
Do not tag for the subtraction operations themselves unless the step explicitly finalizes and simplifies the result.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator for fraction parts.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items whose fractional parts have unlike denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when a fraction is only simplified or normalized without creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing steps that use n/n after a common denominator is already available.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more workable equivalent form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fraction parts into a mixed number.
Do not tag simplification of a final answer unless it is part of rewriting an operand before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like fractions and subtracting whole parts and fraction parts separately in mixed-number problems.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when mixed-number solutions subtract whole parts and fraction parts separately.
Tag whether the intermediate fraction result is positive, zero, or negative.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the prior step of finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag final simplification or recombination alone if no subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a full fraction unit to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part after the fractional subtraction is negative or cannot be completed directly.
Tag when 1 whole is converted to d/d or to an equivalent full fraction such as 24/24 and added to the fractional part.
Tag in whole-minus-fraction, whole-minus-mixed, and mixed-minus-mixed cases requiring regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag simple subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts without borrowing.
Do not tag normalization of an operand before subtraction unless a whole is actually borrowed during the subtraction process.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction or mixed-number fractional part to lowest terms, including recognizing when a zero fraction simplifies to a whole number or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution reduces a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or when a mixed number with zero fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
Tag when an operand's fraction part is simplified before subtraction and that simplification is explicitly performed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag mere recombination into mixed-number form if no reduction occurs.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion for common denominators.
Do not tag borrowing steps that create d/d without reducing the final answer.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an appropriate final form such as a mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one mixed number or integer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted, such as 0 4/5 to 4/5.
Tag when the final answer is stated after combining previously computed parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final presented form.
Do not tag initial rewrites of operands before subtraction.
